evidence.quote: 若是武曲與破軍不同宮，而命宮與身宮分別有此二星曜坐入，則前述武破同宮的命理作用，仍然適用

assessments.expressible_completed: Negative 同宫 with Wu Qu and Po Jun, complete separate-palaces antecedent and no invented location is valid. Earlier Hai Life placements for BOTH stars have a different explicit conjunction premise and are valid, not contradicted by the later separated scenario. Hai/Si conjunction branches are independently stated, not an OR expansion.
assessments.ordinary_fix: relations.1 has evidence only 在巳則合為旺宮; expand evidence to the adjacent full sentence containing 武曲與破軍 / 武破, while preserving the original Si branch condition. This is evidence completeness, not a contract gap.
assessments.typed_gap: Two stars occupy Life and Body separately, but the text does not determine which star occupies which palace. A negative conjunction only says not co-located; it does not encode the one-to-one assignment set {(WuQu Life,PoJun Body),(PoJun Life,WuQu Body)}. No independent full branch picks either permutation.
assessments.unsafe: Do not choose order from prose order, emit both assignments as unconditional, or create four placements that imply each star occupies both palaces.

evidence.quote: 故武曲及文星，若身命各得其一
若是武曲與昌曲分坐命身宮，其作用亦同。
武曲在旺宮坐命並坐會昌曲

assessments.expressible_completed: Existing Wu Qu in Life under full strong-Life/meeting-ChangQu premise is supported. Wen Chang and Wen Qu individually have explicit conceptual discussion, so their mentions and registered pair mention are supported; this does not force their actual co-location.
assessments.negative_relation_boundary: The separated Life/Body scenario entails that Wu Qu is not in the same palace as the literary-star side of that scenario. It does not independently select Wen Chang versus Wen Qu or prove both named stars simultaneously occupy the opposite palace. Under current star-only relation representation, do not emit two unqualified negated binary objects from the ambiguous literary-side reference. A negative relation may be encoded only when its actual participants and source scope are resolved without adding a bearer assumption; until then preserve this negative fact in exact source/evidence and the mapping hold.
assessments.typed_gap: Neither fixed WuQu-Life/literary-Body versus the reverse assignment, nor a unique individual bearer for 文星, is selected by a complete independent source clause. 昌曲 can refer collectively, while ancient quotation discusses WenChang and WenQu alternatives. Do not silently resolve this into both individual occupants or into one selected star.
assessments.independent_branches: 武曲逢文昌 and 逢文曲 are separate source statements about meeting and five-element effects, NOT explicit same-palace or Life/Body assignments. They cannot repair mapping by being relabelled 同宫.
assessments.qualification: eligible unchanged; whole chunk remains usable except unresolved typed binding, not a source-quality failure

evidence.quote: 例如武曲在卯酉二宮和七殺同坐，在丑未二宮和貪狼同坐，在巳亥二宮和破軍同坐，在寅申二宮和天相同坐，在子午二宮和天府同坐。

assessments.ordinary_error: relations.0–6 store 卯酉/丑未/巳亥/寅申/子午/辰戌 as location scalar. Validator accepts free strings but they are not single actual placements or explicit typed alternatives. Isolate/clear these compound location assertions and retain full original source condition; do not count prose retention as solved group mapping.
assessments.expressible_completed: Five distinct star-pair conjunction statements and two opposing-star relations are explicit. Their participant relations remain expressible without claiming a resolved single branch. Preserve every original full condition, source attribution and malefic qualification when retaining these records.
assessments.expressible_not_yet_completed: Named functional Life Palace does not depend on selecting an earthly branch. Add conditional 星曜入宫 for Wu Qu/Tian Fu under explicit 武府在子午二宮坐命時 and Wu Qu under 武曲在辰戌二墓庫守命時, with location unresolved rather than compound scalar. WuQu/TianXiang under 武相在寅申二宮坐命者 is another explicit Life branch. Retain source-evidence context for registered abbreviations. These are authoring/review tasks, not claims that new records already exist.
assessments.typed_gap: Each individual conjunction rule refers to a two-branch group, not a source-authored independent branch for each member. Five pair rules can be separated because their companions and source clauses differ, but each retains internal branch-set semantics. No arbitrary branch splitting or external opposite-branch table may fill the missing typed mapping.
assessments.not_blanket_hold: Branch-set representation does not block functional Life-Palace facts, pair co-location, opposing-star relations, or the prose distinction between activity and extroversion. Stable personality claims remain qualified by malefics and Migration Palace condition.
